title: Understanding the Derivative
text: The derivative of TUO with respect to $$\theta_0$$ is given by the expression: sum{i ext{=}1}{N}{(3/tip_i-1/theta_0)}. To find the value of $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes TUO, we need to set this derivative to zero and solve for $$\theta_0$$.

title: Setting the Derivative to Zero
text: To find the minimum, set the derivative equal to zero: sum{i ext{=}1}{N}{(3/tip_i-1/theta_0)}=0. This equation will help us solve for the optimal $$\theta_0$$.

title: Solving for $$\Theta_0$$
text: Rearrange the equation sum{i ext{=}1}{N}{(3/tip_i-1/theta_0)}=0 to solve for $$\theta_0$$. This involves isolating $$\theta_0$$ on one side of the equation.

title: Expression for $$\Theta_0$$
text: After rearranging the equation, you should find that $$\theta_0$$ is equal to N*(sum{i ext{=}1}{N}{3/tip_i})**(-1).

title: Choosing the Correct Option
text: Look at the multiple-choice options and identify which one matches the expression for $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes TUO: N*(sum{i ext{=}1}{N}{3/tip_i})**(-1).
